authority: Engineering review aid; tests, bound code and protocol control mechanically decidable facts. No semantic authority is inferred from agent agreement.
delegation: Terra medium read-only runner review; later owned the three instruction guides and three pure evidence-validator files. Root alone launched all tests. No delegated fixtures or Lean execution.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A fixture source-binding violation did not prevent the next fixture.
findings_and_repairs.repair: The ledger reducer rejects any prior terminal with changed source bindings; a pure regression covers it.

findings_and_repairs.finding: A missing fixture ledger could appear to be a fresh budget.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Bind a fixed fixture identity and durable count/tail snapshot; explicitly adopt the first completed batch without rewriting it; reject missing/truncated state.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Declared fixture counts needed a fixed topology interpretation.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Bind maximum counts per named test, including supervisors and attempted failed starts. Charge whole fixture wall time times that maximum.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Attempt-slot and elapsed-time reservation semantics needed to be explicit.
findings_and_repairs.repair: All failed attempts consume a slot; durable elapsed evidence charges normal attempts. Orphans conservatively consume full timeout and additional active budget. Preserve this interpretation in report/entry review.

findings_and_repairs.finding: The protocol names six successful proof reports but separately permits a counterexample.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Keep six reports for SUCCESS. Explicitly review the NEGATIVE target and its counterexample-plus-comparators three-report audit without weakening SUCCESS or the allowlist.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Staging could restart a relative process deadline.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Pass the absolute reservation deadline into the supervisor and test it using a shorter absolute deadline than the relative timeout.

findings_and_repairs.finding: An orphan could have a request but no cleanup receipt.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Prevent overlap during the cleanup window; afterward persist INTERRUPTED/full charge/cleanup stop and retain partial files.

findings_and_repairs.finding: Post-process audit and immutable-input verification could cross the design budget before returning SUCCESS.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Evaluate terminal UTC/monotonic time against session and total active caps, persist a bounded unresolved stop, and test both cap edges.

prior_failure_preserved: CVC-RUNNER-1 remains BOUNDED_UNRESOLVED, including its unknown actual failed-fixture duration. No earlier artifact or bound checkpoint was regenerated.
